purpose: Separate plain query syntax safety from Chinese index/query token consistency; then compare FTS and graph under unchanged native solver protocol.

code.implementation_freeze: separate hash-bound record required before first paid candidate run; no later tuning from holdout

data.source_rule: all KG nodes, edges, node_sources, metadata and other non-FTS table rows stay identical; only derived index copies change

offline.roster: Only40DEV ids, before selecting queries; all240 actually executed old FTS/graph searches (ok or error);4 denied overbudget calls excluded; retain duplicate query events and origin trace ordering. Freeze roster before candidate replay.

factors.query: safe quote each original whitespace atom, AND

factors.index: copy: trigram, same seven raw field values
factors.query: safe quote each original whitespace atom, AND

factors.index: copy: unicode61 with spaces around Go unicode.Han runes in each indexed field
factors.query: same Han transform inside each original quoted atom, AND

controls: unchanged BFS depth and ranking weights
per search10000 and trace total20000 visible characters including errors
no OR, LIKE, stopwords, query-specific exceptions or KG re-extraction
metrics: empty results among successfully executed searches
source-path/line overlap and MRR (provenance localization only, not semantic correctness)
short Han and boundary false adjacency

semantic_gate.review: Independent AI checks required-fact support in actual visible evidence, with exact supporting quotations; opaque factor labels, mapping withheld until verdict. Not a human gold standard.
semantic_gate.selection: Select at most one index candidate for paid comparison only if supported required-fact coverage on fixed6DEV packets improves over literal; consider losses and report them. If neither index candidate improves, keep literal originalDB. Nonempty/provenance overlap alone cannot select a winner.
semantic_gate.tie_break: greater fully-supported fact count; fewer newly unsupported facts; then literal, trigram, han-v1 in that order for equal outcomes

solver.reuse_rule: freeze implementation before pilot; reuse its12 results in formal100 if all code/data/protocol hashes identical; run remaining44questionsx2 only. Any necessary correction requires separate revision and all pilot attempts remain counted. Never rerun existing200 original tasks.

paid_budget.remaining_solver_attempts: 400 minus all pilot attempts; hard caps passed to every runner
paid_budget.budget_exhaustion: Stop automatic calls and retain denominator/failures. Residual cases may receive separately labeled independent AI adjudication under same schema; never claim automatic success.
paid_budget.provider_auth_or_policy_failure: stop subsequent paid phases; do not route around access denial or simulate API success
paid_budget.unit: requests and token ceilings; actual provider usage reported, no invented currency charge

holdout.rule: No holdout per-case inspection for tuning. Only after implementation freeze; report aggregate and preserve cases for audit. Not an untouched generalization set.

grading: existing frozen gold and grade.py rubric/schema; blind method mapping; no gold edits; strict and grounded strict both reported with full denominator; all judge failed attempts and token usage retained
limitations: single-run AI-authored benchmark and AI grading
index profiles also change BM25 norms; trigram changes Latin substring behavior and misses<3runes

legacy graph lacks BM25 propagation; use existing rankfix results as closest graph quality comparator; offline new factors share fixed rankfix baseline
